title: Enabling Population-Based Architectures for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2601.08696v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Neural Combinatorial Optimization (NCO) has mostly focused on learning policies, typically neural networks, that operate on a single candidate solution at a time, either by constructing one from scratch or iteratively improving it. In contrast, decades of work in metaheuristics have shown that maintaining and evolving populations of solutions improves robustness and exploration, and often leads to stronger performance. To close this gap, we study how to make NCO explicitly population-based by learning policies that act on sets of candidate solutions. We first propose a simple taxonomy of population awareness levels and use it to highlight two key design challenges: (i) how to represent a whole population inside a neural network, and (ii) how to learn population dynamics that balance intensification (generating good solutions) and diversification (maintaining variety). translated_title: 面向神经组合优化的基于种群的架构
translated_abstract: 神经组合优化（NCO）主要集中于学习在单个候选解上操作的策略（通常是神经网络），即要么从头构建一个解，要么迭代地改进一个解。相比之下，元启发式方法数十年的研究表明，维护和演化解的种群能够提高鲁棒性和探索能力，并常常带来更强的性能。为了弥合这一差距，我们研究如何通过学习作用于候选解集合的策略，使NCO显式地基于种群。我们首先提出了种群感知级别的简单分类法，并用它来强调两个关键设计挑战：（i）如何在神经网络中表示整个种群，（ii）如何学习平衡强化（生成高质量解）与多样化（保持多样性）的种群动态。我们通过两个互补的工具使这些想法具体化……
tldr: 该论文研究如何使神经组合优化（NCO）显式地基于种群，提出了种群感知级别的分类法，指出了在神经网络中表示整个种群以及学习平衡强化与多样化的种群动态这两个关键设计挑战，并用两个互补的工具将其落地。
en_tdlr: This paper enables explicit population-based neural combinatorial optimization by proposing a taxonomy of population awareness levels, identifying two key design challenges—representing entire populations within neural networks and learning population dynamics that balance intensification and diversification—and realizing these ideas with two complementary tools.
